claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Mevastatin is expected to be largely inactive at 2.5 uM over 5 days, since HMGCR inhibition is cytostatic rather than cytotoxic in most cancer cell lines and no member of the screened mechanism vocabulary shares a mevalonate-pathway killing pattern.
